mapper.select:
SELECT t.pay32_insure_pay_id AS insure_pay_id, t.pay32_company_id AS company_id, t.pay32_person_id AS person_id, t.pay32_year AS year, t.pay32_insure_cd AS insure_cd, t.pay32_tgt_amt AS tgt_amt, t.pay32_pay_cd AS pay_cd, t.pay32_pay_div AS pay_div, t.pay32_date AS date, t.pay32_cnt AS cnt, t.pay32_amt AS amt, t.pay32_rem_amt AS rem_amt, emp01_emp_no AS person_no, emp01_kor_nm AS person_nm, f_cdnm('InsureCode', pay32_insure_cd, pay32_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS insure_nm, f_cdnm('DivPayCode', pay32_pay_cd, pay32_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS pay_nm FROM ( SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pay32_person_id, pay32_year, pay32_insure_cd ORDER BY pay32_date DESC, COALESCE(pay32_cnt, 0) DESC) AS rn FROM pay32_insure_pay ) t INNER JOIN emp01_person ON emp01_person_id = pay32_person_id WHERE rn = 1 AND pay32_company_id = #{companyId} AND pay32_year LIKE #{year} AND pay32_insure_cd LIKE #{insureCode}
AND pay32_person_id = #{personId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pay32_insure_pay (pay32_insure_pay_id, pay32_company_id, pay32_person_id, pay32_year, pay32_insure_cd, pay32_tgt_amt, pay32_pay_cd, pay32_pay_div, pay32_date, pay32_cnt, pay32_amt, pay32_rem_amt) VALUES (#{insurePayId}, #{companyId}, #{req.personId}, #{req.year}, #{req.insureCd}, #{req.tgtAmt}, #{req.payCd}, #{req.payDiv}, #{req.date}, #{req.cnt}, #{req.amt}, #{req.remAmt})
mapper.update: UPDATE pay32_insure_pay SET pay32_person_id = #{req.personId}, pay32_year = #{req.year}, pay32_insure_cd = #{req.insureCd}, pay32_tgt_amt = #{req.tgtAmt}, pay32_pay_cd = #{req.payCd}, pay32_pay_div = #{req.payDiv}, pay32_date = #{req.date}, pay32_cnt = #{req.cnt}, pay32_amt = #{req.amt}, pay32_rem_amt = #{req.remAmt} WHERE pay32_insure_pay_id = #{req.insurePayId} AND pay32_company_id = #{companyId}
